findings.technique_name: Secret Theft via Tool Arguments (Confused-Agent Argument Passing)

Baseline all autostart locations and alert on any change, with the writing process identified — treat agent-toolchain writes to these paths as hostile until reviewed.

findings.technique_name: Secrets and Sudo Tokens Present in Agent Context
findings.mitigation: Never place long-lived secrets in agent context: issue short-lived, narrowly scoped tokens per task, and keep the actual secrets in a vault the agent calls through a broker it cannot read.
